capabilities.name: Logging
capabilities.summary: AppLogger, the one logger in this service: every line carries a request id and secrets are redacted before the line reaches the sink.
capabilities.contract: AppLogger.withRequestId(id, sink?) returns a logger bound to one request id; info/warn/error emit a LogLine {level, requestId, message, fields}; redact(fields) replaces secret-looking keys and values with [REDACTED] before the line reaches the sink. Implementation: src/platform/logging/AppLogger.ts.

capabilities.name: Request routing
capabilities.summary: Router.add(method, path, handler) registers a route and Router.dispatch(req) picks the handler for method plus path, passing it an AppLogger bound to req.requestId.
capabilities.contract: Router.add(method, path, handler); Router.dispatch(req) calls the matching handler with an AppLogger bound to req.requestId. Implementation: src/http/router.ts.
